newsitem.title: UK: Cantab Pharma says TA-GW progresses.
newsitem.headline: Cantab Pharma says TA-GW progresses.

text.p: British biotech-based drug development group Cantab Pharmaceuticals Plc said on Friday that it had receieved encouraging patient trials results from the latest studies of its genital warts treatment TA-GW, being jointly developed with SmithKline Beecham Plc.

In an announcement made in parallel with its third quarter results, the company said it had demonstrated "an excellent safety outcome for the vaccine in patients, as well as the ability of TA-GW to stimulate an immune response to the virus which causes genital warts."

"These results, which demonstrate proof of principle, are encouraging and we expect that these clinical responses will be enhanced when the product is formulated with SmithKline's proprietary adjuvant systems", Jurek Sikorski, the company's chief executive, said in the statement.

Cantab said it was presenting the Phase IIa trial results for its ground-breaking treatment of genital warts -- a common sexually-transmitted condition -- to coincide with presentations to the 15th International Papillomavirus Workshop in Brisbane, Australia.

In the company's third quarter results a sharp rise in revenues as the latest TA-GW licensing payments kicked in helped produce a profit for the period of 1.4 million stg, as well as a sharp drop in the year-to-date loss to 2.3 million stg from 4.6 million stg in the same 1995 period.
